episode_title: The women who fought back when their jailers assaulted them
script_en: The women who fought back when their jailers assaulted them.
Aliksandria Prout had only been at the Central California Women’s Facility for a few days when a male officer stopped her at a checkpoint.
“You have beautiful lips and beautiful eyes,” he said.

On this episode of The Sunday Story, we feature the first episode of a new three-part series from KQED’s Snap Judgment called “ We Are Jane Doe .” It follows thirteen women and their fight for justice against the jailers who sexually assaulted them.
